prompt:
10 秒，2.39:1，写实动作电影，暴雨中的未来海滨高架。两辆无品牌黑色摩托，前车骑手穿深红防水夹克，后车骑手穿全黑防水服；车辆结构、骑手服装和前后顺序全程一致。
0–3 秒：摄影机贴近湿路面从两车右后方跟随，前车先压弯进入长弧弯道，后车延迟半秒跟进；轮胎持续接地，排水在身后形成低矮扇形水雾。
3–7 秒：镜头平滑抬升到车尾高度，前车骑手短暂回头确认距离后立刻看路；上方列车从相反方向驶过，灯光掠过车身，速度由背景视差与反射表现，车体不拉伸。
7–10 秒：摄影机横移到前车侧面，弯道结束后两车回正，后车保持安全距离。闪电只照亮云层一次，不击中道路。
声音：引擎转速、轮胎排水、雨击头盔、列车低频；无音乐。无事故、无枪械、无额外车辆突然出现、无品牌、无车轮悬空、无道路变形。

8 秒，16:9，真实山地运动摄影。身份锁定：黑色头盔、琥珀护目镜、亮橙色雪服、深蓝单板的成年滑手。保持装备与雪板图案一致。
摄影机在滑手左前方低位平行跟拍。他先屈膝进入缓坡，板刃切入硬雪留下一条连续弧线；随后通过一处柔软风积雪，雪粉因板头受力向右后方喷起，不遮挡头部；他在坡脊做一个小幅直跳，双脚始终固定在雪板上，落地时膝盖缓冲、雪面压出凹痕。镜头不切换，只在跳起时轻微减速，最后恢复真实速度。
高海拔晴天，冷蓝阴影与暖阳边缘光，远山视差缓慢。声音：板刃刮雪、风压、落地闷响。不要雪崩、不要空翻、不要人体旋转异常、不要雪板分裂、不要无人机突然俯冲。

12 秒，16:9，专业体育转播与电影感结合，室内排球决胜分。白蓝队主攻穿 7 号无品牌球衣，红黑队两名拦网者穿 4 号和 11 号；球衣号码位置、球网与场地方向保持一致。
0–3 秒：高位广角显示白蓝队二传把球托向左侧，球沿平滑抛物线移动；摄影机快速但稳定地平移跟球。
3–7 秒：切到网侧 120fps 感近景，7 号完成三步助跑、起跳、挥臂，红黑队两人同时起跳形成双人拦网；手掌、球和球网空间清楚，球先碰拦网指尖再改变方向。
7–10 秒：地面低机位，球落在边线内，木地板轻微反弹一次，裁判手势指向白蓝队。运动员先确认落点再开始欢呼。
10–12 秒：摄影机推近 7 号与队友击掌，不越过球网轴线。
声音：鞋底摩擦、击球、球触指尖、落地、观众延迟爆发；无解说。不要球穿手、不要多球、不要号码变化、不要身体碰撞或夸张特效。

title_zh: 巷道跑酷的空间连续性
prompt:
10 秒，9:16，写实城市跑酷，清晨旧砖仓库巷道。运动者锁定：浅灰连帽衫、黑色运动裤、白底深绿跑鞋，短卷发；所有动作由同一人连续完成。
0–3 秒：摄影机从背后手持跟随，他跑向齐腰砖墙，左脚踏墙、双手撑顶，屈膝越过，落地时右脚先接触地面并有灰尘轻扬。
3–7 秒：不切镜，摄影机从墙侧绕过 30 度。他继续两步后抓住低矮金属横杆，身体自然摆动半圈，从另一侧松手落地；横杆轻微振动但不弯曲。
7–10 秒：他减速滑过半开的仓库门，门框遮挡镜头后，摄影机停在室内看他跑向天窗光束，最终不是继续加速而是站定呼吸。
自然阴天侧光，砖墙、鞋底和尘土真实。声音：脚步、手掌接触砖面、金属轻响、呼吸。无危险高空、无超能力、无肢体扭曲、无墙体移动、无镜头穿墙。

6 秒，16:9，日落海边运动广告。运动员锁定：深色皮肤女性、紧束高马尾、白色无袖运动上衣、珊瑚色裙裤、无品牌蓝色球拍。保持脸、服装、球拍和用手习惯一致。
0–2 秒：侧面全身景，她左手垂直抛球，球上升到头顶上方一拍高度，右手球拍在身后准备；海风把马尾和裙摆向同一方向吹动。
2–4 秒：以自然慢动作完成屈膝、蹬地、肩部旋转和击球，球拍甜区只接触球一次，网线轻微形变后恢复；脚下细沙因蹬地向后散开。
4–6 秒：摄影机从侧面平滑转向后方，球飞向海边球场对角线，运动员落地稳定，视线跟球。夕阳轮廓光不过曝，肤色自然。
声音：呼吸、击球清脆声、沙粒、海浪；无音乐。只出现一个球，不要球拍弯曲，不要多余手臂，不要鞋子消失，不要直接面向太阳眩光遮挡主体。

10 秒，16:9，电影制作幕后风格的微缩特效实验。木质工作台上放着原创微缩海港：三栋仓库、一座红色无字灯塔、两艘固定小船；模型布局和数量全程一致。画面边缘可见戴灰色手套的特效师双手。
0–3 秒：微距滑轨镜头沿码头横移，场景像真实海港，只有比例线索极少；天空用深蓝幕布和柔光模拟。
3–7 秒：特效师在画外启动风机与细水喷雾，水面产生同方向波纹，仓库旗杆上的空白旗帜受风，灯塔灯旋转一次。小船被细线限制，只轻微起伏，不撞击码头。
7–10 秒：摄影机快速后拉，揭示整个海港只是桌面模型、风机和灯具；特效师关机，水雾缓慢落下，形成幽默而清晰的尺度反转。
声音先是放大的风浪与港口钟，揭示后切回小风机和水泵的真实声音。无建筑摧毁、无洪水、无人员伤亡、无文字、无模型凭空增加。

8 秒，16:9，高端虚构香氛广告。产品锁定：深翡翠色矮方形切面玻璃瓶、圆角肩部、金色短圆瓶盖、正面空白标签区、液面位于瓶身 80%；所有镜头保持比例、颜色、瓶盖与标签位置不变。
0–2 秒：黑色镜面水面上方，摄影机微距贴近玻璃棱线，一滴透明水珠向下滑动，折射出一条金色轮廓光。
2–5 秒：摄影机顺时针环绕 60 度，产品本身不旋转。半透明叶片和细液体丝带被同一股气流从右后方卷起，沿瓶身后侧通过，不遮挡正面空白区。
5–8 秒：瓶子缓慢下降但不接触水面，空气压力形成同心波纹；最后所有液体丝带在后方组成简洁拱形并停住。
黑、翡翠绿、暖金，真实玻璃折射、焦散与微小划痕。声音：水滴、低沉气流、结尾一声细金属音。无文字、无手、无商标、无瓶体软化、无液体穿透玻璃、无突然爆炸。

10 秒，16:9，精密工业设计广告。虚构头戴式耳机：哑光石墨灰椭圆耳罩、薄香槟金铰链、深灰织物头梁、无标志。产品几何、左右结构和材质全程固定。
0–3 秒：耳机以折叠状态放在浅灰无缝台面，顶光在金属边缘形成细线。摄影机以 85mm 产品镜头缓慢推近，背景静止。
3–7 秒：左右耳罩按真实铰链顺序展开：左侧先旋转 90 度并锁定，右侧随后镜像展开，头梁只上升少量。每次锁定都有可见的机械停顿，零件不分裂、不悬浮。
7–10 秒：摄影机降低到与耳罩齐平，柔和声波可视化仅以背景空气中的细微同心折射出现；耳机保持静止，最终构图留出右侧文案空间但不生成文字。
极简银灰与暖金，柔和高键灯光，金属拉丝和织物纹理清晰。声音：两次清脆机械卡扣、低频脉冲一次。不要额外按钮、不要电线、不要磁悬浮爆炸、不要品牌或乱码。

title_zh: 冰茶从茶园到餐桌的匹配剪辑
prompt:
12 秒，9:16，清爽饮料社交广告，虚构无标签玻璃瓶。产品锁定：细长透明瓶、琥珀色茶液、银白瓶盖、瓶身无字。
0–4 秒：清晨茶园微距，一片带露水的茶叶被手指轻摘；叶片向下移动经过镜头形成遮挡。
4–8 秒：动作匹配切到透明冰块从上方落入高杯，茶液随后沿杯壁注入，冰块只碰撞两次，水汽在杯外凝结。摄影机保持竖屏中心构图，阳光从左后方穿过琥珀色液体。
8–12 秒：同一片茶叶落在木桌边，焦点从叶片移到后方无标签茶瓶和杯子；一阵微风推动白色桌布但产品不移动。最后一个气泡沿冰块边缘上升并破裂。
声音以采茶轻响连接冰块碰撞，再进入倒茶声与夏日远蝉。自然绿色、琥珀金、洁净白。无商标、无可读文字、无夸张液体飞溅、瓶盖不消失、杯中冰块不融化变形。

title_zh: 模块化台灯的日夜变换
prompt:
10 秒，16:9，北欧感家居科技广告。产品锁定：奶白色圆盘底座、细黑立杆、可旋转半月形灯头、单个黄铜触控点；桌面位置和比例固定。
0–3 秒：白天书桌，灯关闭。摄影机从书架空隙缓慢横移，显示纸张、陶杯与一株小蕨；所有物体真实投影。
3–7 秒：一只手触碰黄铜点一次，灯头沿真实转轴向下旋转 35 度，暖光逐渐亮起。同时窗外天色以平滑时间流逝从下午过渡到蓝调夜晚，但桌上物体不跳位。
7–10 秒：手离开，摄影机轻轻推近灯下书页和陶杯蒸汽；暖光只照亮工作区，背景保持冷蓝。右上角留空但不生成文字。
声音：触控轻音、转轴微响、日间鸟鸣过渡到夜晚远车声。不要让灯自行拆分，不要多出按钮，不要改变书桌布局，不要品牌或字幕。

title_zh: 巧克力薄片的声画节拍
prompt:
6 秒，1:1，精品黑巧克力微距广告，强调 ASMR。虚构产品：四乘四格深色巧克力薄片，每格只有抽象放射纹，无文字无标志。
0–2 秒：超微距侧逆光，一把细刀沿格线缓慢施压，巧克力表面出现真实细裂纹，摄影机完全静止。
2–4 秒：薄片在格线处干净断开，碎屑只向前落下少量；断裂声与画面精准同步，焦点从刀锋转到粗糙断面。
4–6 秒：断开的方块落入一杯热可可，液面下沉后形成一次圆形回弹，一缕蒸汽遮住镜头作为结束。
深棕、铜金、奶油色，高对比但不过曝，真实可食用质感。只出现一把刀和一只杯子；不要融化成塑料、不要无限碎裂、不要手指进入刀锋区域、不要包装或文字。

title_zh: 概念电动车的风洞光绘
prompt:
10 秒，2.39:1，原创概念电动车发布片。车辆锁定：低矮四门快背轮廓、珍珠灰车漆、连续但无标志的前灯带、五辐封闭轮毂、无车牌文字；车身比例与轮毂始终一致。
0–3 秒：黑色风洞内，车辆静止，只有一条白色扫描光从车头移动到车尾，揭示曲面与漆面微粒。摄影机在前左 3/4 角低位静止。
3–7 秒：蓝白色空气流线从前方掠过，沿车顶和侧面弯曲，流线只表现气流不穿透车身；摄影机沿车辆侧面平稳滑轨移动，车轮不转。
7–10 秒：气流熄灭，前灯从中心向两侧渐亮，摄影机停在后左 3/4 角；地面反射与车辆位置匹配，背景留出上方空间。
声音：风洞低频、扫描电子音、灯光启动轻音；无引擎轰鸣。不要打开车门、不要车辆变形、不要驾驶员、不要品牌、不要文字、不要让摄影机穿过车体。

12 秒，2.39:1，原创东方幻想电影，写实山体与克制水墨粒子结合。身份锁定：青年女剑客，长黑发半束，象牙白内袍、靛蓝长外衣、旧银护腕、腰间无纹长剑；脸、发型、服装和剑全程一致。
0–4 秒：黎明云海超广角，她站在狭窄玄武岩桥端，远处第一群纸鹤从右下方逆风进入，衣摆和发丝向左摆动。
4–8 秒：摄影机缓慢推近到全身景，纸鹤绕太阳形成向内收拢的螺旋门；她没有拔剑，只向前迈一步，脚落地时岩面细尘向外散开。
8–12 秒：摄影机轻微升高，螺旋门后的群峰显露，纸鹤保持纸张折痕与统一飞行方向。她抬头，护腕反射一道晨光，画面停在肃静而非爆炸的奇观。
声音：山风、纸翼轻响、远处钟声一次、极轻弦乐。无对白、无文字。不要已有角色、不要法术光束、不要纸鹤变成鸟、不要剑漂浮、不要人物站位跳变。

10 秒，16:9，手绘 2D 动画与纸张纹理。古老圆形图书馆，一名戴圆眼镜、穿芥末黄背带裤的小男孩伏在大地图上睡着。角色采用简洁线条、有限色块和轻微逐帧抖动，但脸部与服装保持一致。
0–3 秒：蓝黑墨水从地图上的海域缓慢聚集，先形成尾鳍，再形成一条半透明鲸鱼；墨水总量连续，不从桌面滴落。
3–7 秒：鲸鱼游离纸面，在书架之间缓慢上升，经过时书页被气流翻动。摄影机以 2D 多层视差向上跟随，前景梯子、中景鲸鱼、后景书架移动速度不同。
7–10 秒：鲸鱼穿过圆顶天窗变成夜空星座，蓝色墨点排列成鲸形；男孩醒来抬头，眼镜反光中出现星座，地图恢复为空白海面。
声音：纸页、柔和水下回声、木结构轻响；无对白。不要 3D 塑料质感、不要真实水淹图书馆、不要改变角色年龄、不要文字或现成角色。

title_zh: 苔藓机器人照料最后一株花
prompt:
10 秒，1:1，原创定格动画质感。废弃温室里，一个由旧黄铜盒、两条木质手臂和圆形玻璃眼组成的小机器人，身体覆盖少量苔藓；面前是一株只有两片叶子的白花。机器人结构、苔藓位置和花朵数量保持一致。
0–3 秒：机器人用双手捧起生锈小水壶，关节以可见的逐格节奏转动，玻璃眼内部暖光变亮。
3–7 秒：它缓慢倾斜水壶，只有三滴水落入土壤；第三滴落下后土壤颜色变深，白花从垂下状态轻轻抬起，而不是快速生长。
7–10 秒：温室破窗透入一道晨光，机器人把水壶放回原位，头部向花朵倾斜 10 度；一只纸做的小蛾停在它肩上，玻璃眼眨动一次作为结束。
材料呈现手工木纹、黄铜氧化、羊毛苔藓和指纹感，暖绿与旧金。声音：关节咔嗒、水滴、玻璃温室风声。无对白、无品牌、无机械零件增殖、无突然花海。

15 秒，2.39:1，原创高幻想动画电影。身份锁定：16 岁信使，深棕短发、青绿色厚披风、白色毛领、背小皮邮袋；光兽是一只鹿形半透明生物，角像缓慢流动的极光。两者外观全程一致。
0–5 秒：蓝调冰原远景，信使沿冰裂边缘小心前行，远处光兽在风雪中逐渐显形；脚印连续留在身后。
5–10 秒：中景，信使从邮袋取出一枚圆形铜片放在冰面，后退半步。光兽靠近，用鼻尖触碰铜片，接触点出现一圈柔光沿冰裂向外扩散，但冰面不破碎。
10–15 秒：摄影机环绕两者 45 度，暴风雪逐渐减弱，极光角在天空映出通往山口的路线；信使抬头理解方向，光兽转身先走一步，邀请她跟随。
声音：风雪、皮靴压雪、铜片轻响、遥远合唱氛围。无对白。不要已有怪物设计、不要骑乘、不要战斗、不要人体变形、不要让铜片变成武器。

8 秒，16:9，明亮复古未来主义 3D 动画。巨大环形太空城内侧，一台橙白色双吸盘窗户清洁机器人沿弧形观景窗工作，机器人有一只方形显示眼和两条短机械臂；结构与颜色不变。
0–3 秒：摄影机在室内跟随机器人横向移动，窗外可见弯曲地平线、农田与倒挂建筑。左吸盘固定，右吸盘向前移动并重新吸附，动作符合交替爬行。
3–6 秒：机器人喷出少量泡沫，用圆形刷头擦出一条清晰弧线；透过干净区域，一艘小型通勤飞船从远处缓慢经过，视差真实。
6–8 秒：机器人发现一块顽固污点，显示眼变成专注的窄线，再用刷头快速擦两下；污点消失，它显示一个简单亮点而非文字。
干净几何、柔和橙蓝配色、可信塑料与金属。声音：吸盘、微电机、泡沫、轻快电子节奏。不要让机器人脱离玻璃、不要无限手臂、不要宇宙爆炸、不要文字或商标。

12 秒，4:3，原创纸偶与剪影动画，舞台材质清晰可见。小型木框纸偶剧场中，一个红衣旅行者纸偶站在桥左侧，一只蓝灰色龙形剪影藏在山后；所有角色由可见细杆操控，纸张边缘和关节保持一致。
0–4 秒：暖色背光亮起，旅行者向桥中央移动三小步，每步都是有限关节纸偶动作；山后龙影缓慢升起，看似巨大威胁。
4–8 秒：龙影张口，旅行者举起小盾牌。背光突然侧移，揭示“巨龙”其实是一只很小的蜥蜴纸偶靠近灯源造成的放大影子。
8–12 秒：旅行者放下盾牌，把一张叶子形纸片递给小蜥蜴；蜥蜴叼走叶子，影子也随距离缩小。镜头最后后拉，露出舞台边缘、操偶细杆和观众席一排孩子的剪影。
声音：纸张摩擦、木杆轻响、孩子压低的惊叹与笑声。无对白、无字幕。不要真实动物、不要火焰、不要纸偶变成立体人物、不要隐藏所有操控结构。

18 seconds, 16:9, truthful real-estate walkthrough of a fictional 32-square-meter studio. Geometry lock: entry door, kitchenette, fold-down table, sofa bed, one east-facing window, and bathroom door must keep exact positions and proportions.
00:00–00:06: Start at normal standing eye level just inside the entry with a 28mm-equivalent lens, no fisheye. Move forward one meter to reveal the kitchenette on the left and closed bathroom door on the right; pause so the narrow clearance is visible.
00:06–00:12: Turn slowly toward the living area. A resident lowers the wall table using both hands and places one chair, demonstrating real walking clearance without removing furniture.
00:12–00:18: Continue to the window, then turn back toward the entry in one continuous movement, showing the full path and sofa-bed depth. Finish on a stable wide frame with no hidden wall.
Audio: room tone, hinge, distant street. Natural morning light and neutral grade. No impossible wide-angle expansion, moving walls, duplicated doors, instant decluttering, fake view, text, logo, or watermark.

15 seconds, 2.39:1, architectural previsualization of an original transit plaza at weekday morning peak. Fixed elements: tram stop, two shelters, four shade trees, raised crossing, protected cycle lane, and ground-floor café; preserve all counts and routes.
00:00–00:05: Camera begins at pedestrian eye level under a shelter. A tram arrives on the left track while cyclists continue through the protected lane; passengers wait behind the tactile edge.
00:05–00:10: Track beside one parent with a stroller crossing on the raised table after the signal changes. A delivery cyclist slows and yields; no collision or crowd teleportation.
00:10–00:15: Lift only to second-floor height, revealing how walking, cycling, tram, and café seating fit without overlap. Tree shadows match the morning sun and shelter roofs provide real coverage.
Audio: tram bell, rolling wheels, footsteps, restrained city ambience. No futuristic pods, impossible traffic flow, inaccessible curb, vehicle crossing through people, changing tree count, advertising text, or watermark.

20 seconds, 16:9, route-validation film inside a fictional public library. Follow an adult power-wheelchair user wearing a burgundy jacket from entrance to a low-height book pickup shelf. Keep identity, wheelchair geometry, route, doors, and furniture fixed.
00:00–00:05: Exterior automatic door opens before arrival; camera tracks at seated eye level from the side. Threshold remains flush and the user enters without assistance.
00:05–00:10: Continue through the lobby. The user pauses at a low information display, turns within a clearly visible circle, then follows a high-contrast floor stripe.
00:10–00:15: At one aisle, another patron moves a small step aside while maintaining comfortable distance. Shelf spacing remains honest; the wheelchair does not narrow or clip furniture.
00:15–00:20: The user reaches the pickup shelf, scans a card, and retrieves one book from reachable height. Finish with an unobstructed route visible behind.
Audio: door motor, quiet library, wheel motor, scan confirmation. No inspirational narration, hidden ramps, staff pushing the chair, changing aisle width, unreadable policy claims, logo, or watermark.

15 seconds, 16:9, lifestyle architecture film showing how four adults share a compact co-living kitchen. Geometry lock: one island, two induction zones, sink, refrigerator, and four stools; keep people, wardrobe colors, props, and left-right relationships consistent.
00:00–00:05: Wide corner view. Blue-shirt resident chops fruit at the island; yellow-sweater resident fills a kettle at the sink; red-cardigan resident opens the refrigerator; gray-shirt resident enters and hangs a bag. Paths do not intersect.
00:05–00:10: Camera slides behind the island. Refrigerator closes before gray-shirt resident passes; kettle moves to the induction zone; fruit bowl is placed at the center. Show realistic counter depth and hand contact.
00:10–00:15: All four sit or lean at different sides of the island, sharing breakfast while the workspace remains navigable. End on a top-down plan-like view from modest ceiling height, not an impossible cutaway.
Audio: knife, kettle, refrigerator, casual low conversation without exact dialogue. No magically clean counters, duplicated food, colliding bodies, changing kitchen dimensions, brand, text, or watermark.

12 seconds, 9:16, realistic urban mobility mini-documentary. Vehicle lock: forest-green long-tail electric bicycle, two tan insulated panniers, front light, no logo. Rider wears matte black helmet, cream rain shell, dark trousers; preserve vehicle, cargo count, clothing, and travel direction.
00:00–00:04: At a bakery loading curb, rider secures two bread crates inside the panniers and checks both straps. Camera stays close enough to show real fastening, with kickstand down.
00:04–00:08: Rider retracts kickstand, starts smoothly, and enters a protected lane after checking behind. Low side tracking shows both tires contacting wet pavement and panniers remaining stable over a speed table.
00:08–00:12: At a café, rider brakes, places left foot down, and opens only the right pannier to hand over one sealed crate. Finish on a quick receipt scan with no readable customer data.
Audio: straps, freewheel, light rain, bell once, brake, scan. No dangerous sidewalk riding, cargo teleportation, wheel deformation, brand, address, fake sustainability number, or watermark.

15 seconds, 2.39:1, industrial night-shift documentary inside a tram depot. Two adult technicians wear navy coveralls, reflective vests, gloves, and eye protection. Tram lock: silver body, blue stripe, four visible doors on this side; preserve staff, tools, body panels, and track position.
00:00–00:05: Wide static shot. Tram is fully stopped, power-isolation indicator is visibly active as a simple red lock icon. Technician A places wheel chocks; Technician B confirms against a tablet with no readable private data.
00:05–00:10: Low tracking shot follows a handheld inspection light along wheel and brake components. Technician A points to one normal wear surface; no hands enter pinch zones.
00:10–00:15: Camera rises beside the body as Technician B checks door alignment using a physical gauge. They close the access panel, remove tools, and sign off together before power changes.
Audio: depot ventilation, metal tool contact, brief radio confirmation. No live-track danger, sparks, moving tram, missing PPE, technical claim beyond visible inspection, logo, or watermark.

14 seconds, 16:9, realistic prototype test of a fictional small electric river ferry with supervised autonomous docking. Ferry lock: white catamaran, teal roof, two side bumpers, twelve empty seats, one onboard safety operator; preserve hull, passenger count, dock, and river direction.
00:00–00:05: Shore camera sees ferry approach at low speed, aligned slightly upstream. Water wake remains small; safety operator watches controls with hands nearby.
00:05–00:10: Overhead camera at crane height, not satellite height. Ferry rotates less than 15 degrees and uses two visible side thrusters; bow and stern maintain clearance while wind pushes a small surface ripple downstream.
00:10–00:14: Side close-up as the teal bumper contacts the dock gently, compresses, then settles. Automatic mooring arm engages one fixed point; operator confirms before the gate unlocks, but no passenger boards.
Audio: water, electric motor hum, soft contact, confirmation tone. No claim of unsupervised safety, high-speed impact, changing hull, impossible zero wake, people on deck, brand, or watermark.

18 seconds, 16:9, honest hospitality walkthrough of an original accessible hotel room. Guest uses a manual wheelchair and wears a dark green jacket. Geometry lock: inward entry, transfer space beside bed, low wardrobe rail, roll-in shower, fold-down seat, and reachable controls; preserve dimensions and fixture positions.
00:00–00:06: Follow from hallway at seated eye level as the guest unlocks the room, opens the door, and turns inside without reversing into furniture. Door and wardrobe clearances remain visible.
00:06–00:12: Guest approaches the bed, demonstrates unobstructed side transfer space without transferring, then reaches one bedside light control. Camera stays wide enough to show reach and floor area.
00:12–00:18: Cut to bathroom entrance from the room side. Guest rolls across a flush threshold, turns toward the shower, and lowers the fold-down seat by hand. End on a wide view showing grab bars and clear floor space together.
Audio: key lock, wheels, switch, shower-seat hinge. No luxury exaggeration, hidden threshold, magically expanding room, staff assistance without consent, fake certification, brand, text, or watermark.

title_zh: Courtyard light study from dawn to evening
prompt:
15 seconds, 16:9, architectural light study of one original brick courtyard. Lock all geometry: L-shaped wall, three arched openings, shallow reflecting pool, one olive tree, two benches. Camera remains on the same tripod and lens for the full sequence.
00:00–00:05: Dawn. Cool skylight fills the courtyard, warm sun first touches the upper right brick edge; pool is still and benches are empty.
00:05–00:10: Smooth but honest time transition to midday. Shadows shorten according to the same sun path; two people cross once for scale without moving furniture. Olive leaves create detailed shadow texture.
00:10–00:15: Continue to blue-hour evening. Concealed low lights turn on sequentially along the arches; the pool reflects them with slight wind ripples. End with the same framing as the first frame.
Audio transitions from morning birds to midday footsteps to evening crickets; no dramatic music. No moving walls, changing tree, impossible two-sun shadows, seasonal change, furniture jump, logo, or watermark.

18 seconds, 16:9, human-scale previsualization of a fictional primary-school afternoon pickup. Fixed layout: school gate, raised crossing, protected cycle lane, short bus bay, three family pickup spaces, and continuous sidewalk; preserve all routes and vehicle counts.
00:00–00:06: Eye-level camera beside the gate. Children exit with adults onto the wide sidewalk while one school bus stops completely in its bay. No child enters the vehicle lane.
00:06–00:12: Follow a family walking across the raised crossing after a crossing guard signals. A cyclist approaches in the protected lane, slows before the crossing, and continues only after the family clears.
00:12–00:18: Rise to second-floor height to show one pickup car leaving forward, the bus bay remaining unobstructed, and the sidewalk route continuing behind parked vehicles. End on clearly separated movement paths.
Audio: school bell, low conversation, bicycle freewheel, one crossing whistle. No speeding, double parking, child alone in traffic, vehicle teleportation, inaccessible curb, readable school name, brand, or watermark.

20 seconds, 16:9, logistics rehearsal for an original temporary emergency shelter module, presented as a prototype rather than a certified solution. Module lock: gray floor cassette, four blue wall panels, two roof halves, eight numbered fasteners shown only as colored shapes; preserve component count and scale.
00:00–00:05: Four trained adults in gloves unload components onto a marked flat pad, keeping the access route clear. Camera begins high enough to show the complete layout.
00:05–00:10: Two workers unfold the floor legs while two position the first wall panel into visible slots. Panels retain weight; no part floats into place.
00:10–00:15: Remaining walls connect in sequence, then roof halves lift with a manual pole system and meet at the ridge. Fasteners engage at each corner before hands release.
00:15–00:20: Team installs one ramp and checks the door swing, ventilation opening, and anchor straps. Pull back to show the complete module and remaining safe circulation space.
Audio: panel contact, fasteners, concise team calls. No disaster victims, impossible one-person lift, instant assembly, missing anchors, weather-resistance claim, logo, text, or watermark.

15 秒，2.39:1，克制的现实主义电影短片，冬夜港口。身份锁定：28 岁女性，齐肩黑发，鼻梁有浅雀斑，深灰羊毛大衣，右手戴旧银戒；所有镜头保持同一张脸和服装。
0–4 秒：空旷渡轮下层客舱，中景静止。她独坐在靠窗座位，把一封没有邮票的信压在掌心；窗外港灯随船体轻晃，玻璃上雨水向后流。只有呼吸、拇指摩擦信封边缘和远处发动机低鸣。
4–9 秒：摄影机沿桌面缓慢横移到侧脸近景。广播提示“本班船即将返航”，她抬眼看向对岸邮筒的红色小点，嘴唇微张但没有说话；灯塔扫光经过脸部一次，眼眶反光短暂出现。
9–15 秒：切至船尾外景，保持轴线。她跑出舱门却在栏杆前停下，没有把信丢进海里，而是将它重新放进内袋。摄影机缓慢后退，渡轮离岸，对岸邮筒越来越小。冷青夜色，舱内钨丝灯暖黄，细腻胶片颗粒。
声音：柴油机低频、雨点敲玻璃、舱门液压声、广播女声；最后只留下水浪。无配乐、无字幕。保持信封完整、戒指位置和港口方向一致；不要哭喊、不要慢动作奔跑、不要换脸、不要额外乘客突然出现。

10 秒，16:9，温暖生活电影。暴雨导致街区停电，一间狭小面包店里，58 岁短灰发女店主穿墨绿色围裙，和一个背黄色书包的 9 岁男孩隔着柜台。身份、围裙和书包全程一致。
0–3 秒：灯光突然熄灭，烤箱风扇停下，画面只剩窗外蓝灰色闪电轮廓；两人同时停住动作，男孩抱紧纸袋。
3–7 秒：店主划亮一根火柴，先点燃柜台上的小蜡烛，再把刚出炉的圆面包推向男孩。摄影机从蜡烛微距缓慢拉焦到两张脸，暖光逐步建立，玻璃柜上的倒影符合位置。
7–10 秒：男孩把面包掰成两半，先把较大一半递回给店主；她愣 0.4 秒后笑起来。窗外整条街依次恢复供电，但店内仍以烛光为主，镜头停在两双手和面包蒸汽上。
声音：暴雨、断电的轻响、火柴摩擦、面包脆壳、远处店铺恢复供电的欢呼。无对白、无字幕、无品牌。动作自然克制；不要让蜡烛位置跳变、不要让面包自动复原、不要改变人物年龄。

12 秒，2.39:1，现代都市悬疑，清晨地铁终点站。身份锁定：穿沙色风衣的男记者，左手拿折叠报纸；穿海军蓝制服的女站务员，胸前只有空白名牌。
0–3 秒：超广角建立空月台，一列无乘客列车正要关门。记者从画面深处跑来，摄影机低位平行跟拍，鞋底在湿地留下连续脚印。
3–6 秒：车门在他面前闭合，他抬手敲门；列车内部，一个与他外貌完全相同但穿黑色大衣的人隔着玻璃同步抬手。镜头保持稳定，不做恐怖变形。
6–9 秒：列车启动，玻璃中的相同人物没有随列车移动，而像倒影一样留在原位置半秒后才被带走。记者后退一步，报纸从左手滑落。
9–12 秒：站务员进入前景，弯腰捡起报纸；头版日期是明天，但画面不要求可读文字，只以异常版式暗示。摄影机缓慢推近她困惑的眼神，远处隧道风吹起报纸一角。
冷白荧光、浅雾、对称构图。声音：闭门提示音、鞋步、列车加速、纸张落地；音乐仅用一条低频持续音。保持两名相同人物的脸一致但服装明确不同；无血腥、无怪物、无乱码标题、无越轴。

15 秒，4:3，1950 年代东亚城市年代片，褪色彩色胶片，服装与道具符合时代。夕阳天台，一名穿浅蓝短袖衬衫、深色高腰长裤的青年修理木壳真空管收音机；一名扎低辫、穿米白连衣裙的青年女性扶着晾衣绳。两人身份和服装保持一致。
0–5 秒：固定中景，青年旋动旋钮，只有沙沙电流；晾晒的白床单受风鼓起，周期性遮挡两人，形成自然转场。城市烟囱和旧天线在远景。
5–10 秒：床单掠过镜头后切到手部近景，他轻敲木壳，收音机突然传出舞曲。她先看向收音机，再看向他，伸出右手做邀请姿势。他停顿后把螺丝刀放下。
10–15 秒：摄影机缓慢环绕 45 度，两人在狭小空间只跳两个简单舞步，脚步真实、不滑行。最后床单再次充满画面，声音仍继续半秒作为结束。
夕阳侧逆光，衣料与木材质感真实，轻微胶片抖动但人物不抖。声音：电流、屋顶风、远处自行车铃、年代感舞曲。不要现代建筑、LED、塑料耳机、文字水印或复杂舞蹈。

10 秒，16:9，写实高山救援纪录片，一镜到底。首图人物锁定：橙红色救援服、白色头盔、黑色护目镜的救援员；倒在雪坡上的滑雪者穿钴蓝外套。保持两人服装、装备和雪坡方向不变。
摄影机从救援员肩后开始，以轻微手持但可读的方式向下跟随。他把冰镐固定在左侧硬雪中，半跪降低重心，用右手扣住滑雪者胸前安全带；强风从画面右向左，吹动同一方向的雪粉和衣物。救援绳拉紧后，两人只向上移动半米，雪面出现真实压痕。摄影机绕到侧面不超过 30 度，最后停在安全扣完全闭合的微距，救援员用拇指检查一次锁门。
高海拔冷色散射光，呼吸水汽随风偏移，皮肤不暴露。声音：强风、金属扣清脆闭合、绳索受力、短促无线电“连接完成”。无雪崩、无坠落、无夸张英雄姿势。手套不消失，绳索不穿过身体，人物不在雪面滑行，摄影机不切镜。

title_zh: 厨房到星空的遮挡转场
prompt:
8 秒，9:16，诗意竖屏短片，用一次自然遮挡完成现实到想象的转场。夜晚小厨房，一个 12 岁女孩穿宽松白色睡衣，在桌上把蓝莓放入玻璃碗，父亲只以双手和深蓝毛衣袖口出现。
0–3 秒：俯拍微距，最后一颗蓝莓从女孩指尖滚落，绕碗边一圈后停住；父亲将牛奶从画面上方缓慢倒入，白色液面向镜头扩散。
3–5 秒：牛奶完全遮住画面时无缝变成一片乳白星云，蓝莓对应为深蓝行星，位置与运动方向连续；摄影机继续同一方向向下穿行。
5–8 秒：星云逐渐变回玻璃碗中的早餐，女孩的勺子轻轻搅动一次，窗外第一缕晨光出现。她抬头看向父亲的方向微笑，但父亲不露脸。
梦幻但物理连贯，蓝、乳白、晨金配色。声音桥：牛奶流动声逐渐变为低沉宇宙氛围，最后回到勺子碰碗。无对白、无文字。保持女孩的手、碗和蓝莓数量大致稳定；不要硬切、不要出现宇航员、不要改变厨房布局。

title_zh: How street trees cool a summer block
prompt:
15 seconds, 16:9, accessible science explainer comparing two adjacent fictional city blocks at noon: one with mature street trees, one without. Preserve the same sun position, road width, building materials, traffic level, and camera height.
00:00–00:05: Split-screen aerial descends evenly across both blocks. On the treeless side, hard sunlight reaches pavement; on the shaded side, leaf shadows move naturally. Use a simple warm-to-cool color overlay as explanatory graphics, not fake thermal-camera footage.
00:05–00:10: Street-level match cut. Show water leaving leaf pores as subtle translucent particles and rising air as slow arrows; keep the real trees visible beneath the overlay. A pedestrian waits in each block for scale.
00:10–00:15: Return to the paired wide view as a breeze moves through both streets. End on the practical contrast: shade covers the sidewalk and a bench, while building geometry remains identical.
Audio: cicadas, light traffic, leaves, calm narrator: “Shade reduces direct solar heating; evaporation moves additional heat into the air.” No exact temperature claim, magic cooling, instant tree growth, misleading weather change, logo, or watermark.

12 seconds, 16:9, scientific visualization that clearly transitions from real macro footage to a labeled conceptual microscopic world. Subject: one fictional yellow lily with six stamens; keep flower geometry consistent.
00:00–00:04: Natural macro shot. A soft brush touches one anther and lifts visible pollen dust; camera follows one highlighted grain toward a glass slide.
00:04–00:08: Circular microscope mask closes around the grain. Transition into a realistic scanning-electron-inspired surface visualization, monochrome with a subtle false-color edge. Rotate only 45 degrees to reveal pores and textured outer wall.
00:08–00:12: Pull back to show several grains of the same species, then overlay three minimal callout lines with empty label blocks reserved for accurate post-production text. Return briefly to the original flower for scale.
Audio: soft lab foley and restrained narrator: “Pollen shape and surface vary by plant species.” No claim of live internal motion, no invented cell labels, no changing grain design, no readable fake text, brand, or watermark.

20 seconds, 16:9, clear workshop safety demonstration using a fictional enclosed desktop laser cutter. Adult operator wears tied-back hair, cotton shirt, safety glasses, and no loose jewelry. Machine geometry and workshop layout remain fixed.
00:00–00:05: Operator checks the approved plywood sample and confirms the material label with a printed checklist kept unreadable on camera. They inspect the bed for scraps before placing the sheet flat.
00:05–00:10: They close the transparent lid fully, verify the extraction hose connection, and turn on ventilation. Camera moves from hand contact to the rear hose without crossing through the machine.
00:10–00:15: Through the closed lid, a small test pattern begins. The operator stays beside the machine, watching; flame remains a tiny controlled point and smoke is extracted backward.
00:15–00:20: The test stops. The operator waits, opens the lid, and checks the cut without touching hot material. End on the machine's accessible emergency-stop button.
Audio: ventilation, lid latch, low machine movement; narrator names each step. No unsafe open-lid operation, PVC or unknown material, unattended machine, dramatic fire, unreadable instruction claims, logo, or watermark.

15 seconds, 16:9, classroom-scale lunar eclipse explanation using a lamp as the Sun, a blue globe as Earth, and a small gray Moon sphere on a rod. Teacher's hands and all object sizes remain consistent.
00:00–00:05: Side view establishes the straight lamp–Earth–Moon alignment. Room lights dim; the teacher moves the Moon slowly behind Earth while camera stays perpendicular to avoid misleading perspective.
00:05–00:10: Transition to a clean conceptual space view with the same alignment. Show Earth's broad penumbra and narrow umbra as translucent cones; the Moon enters the penumbra, then the umbra, without changing orbit direction.
00:10–00:15: Match cut back to the tabletop. The Moon sphere emerges from shadow as the teacher slightly adjusts the rod, emphasizing that perfect alignment does not happen every month. Finish on the three-object setup.
Audio: calm narration and quiet classroom. No wrong shadow direction, giant Moon, flat-Earth geometry, rapid spinning, astrology claims, fake labels, logo, or watermark.

15 seconds, 16:9, responsible marine field-note comparison. Use two documented views of the same fictional shallow reef patch, explicitly presented as different survey dates, not a rapid transformation. Preserve rock geometry, camera marker, coral colony shapes, and viewing angle.
00:00–00:05: Survey A. Diver holds a small neutral color card beside healthy branching coral, then removes it. Camera locks on a fixed marker and records fish passing naturally.
00:05–00:10: A date-change transition uses a closing field notebook, not a morph. Survey B shows the same reef geometry with reduced coral color and fewer fish; water clarity and sun direction stay comparable.
00:10–00:15: Split view aligns both surveys. Simple outline highlights the same colony while a diver writes observations on a waterproof slate with text kept unreadable.
Audio: underwater ambience and narrator: “Bleaching is a stress response; field surveys track condition over time.” No instant death, sensational disaster, invented recovery claim, species mutation, diver touching coral, brand, or watermark.

10 seconds, 1:1, classroom physics macro demonstration. A sealed clear acrylic tray contains iron filings above a fixed red-and-blue bar magnet; adult demonstrator wears nitrile gloves. Keep magnet orientation, tray, filing quantity, and camera axis consistent.
00:00–00:03: Top-down shot before motion. The demonstrator gently taps the tray edge once; filings begin moving from random distribution.
00:03–00:07: Filings settle into curved lines around the magnet, densest near both poles. Overlay two subtle arrow paths as explanatory graphics, clearly distinct from the physical filings.
00:07–00:10: Demonstrator rotates the entire sealed tray 90 degrees while the camera remains fixed; the pattern rotates with the magnet, then settles again. End on a clean symmetrical view.
Audio: tray tap, fine granular movement, narrator: “The filings align with the local magnetic field.” No filings floating in air, magnet changing poles, unsealed powder, electrical sparks, fake equations, logo, or watermark.

14 seconds, 16:9, educational cutaway of a fictional gravity-fed teaching filter, not a claim that the output is automatically safe to drink. Device lock: clear upper reservoir, gravel layer, sand layer, activated-carbon layer, lower collection vessel; preserve order and volume.
00:00–00:04: Real tabletop view. Cloudy demonstration water enters the top reservoir slowly, with no hand blocking the device.
00:04–00:10: Transition to a clean cross-section. Follow a small highlighted portion of water downward through gravel, sand, and carbon; suspended particles reduce gradually, and flow slows realistically. Layers do not mix or disappear.
00:10–00:14: Return to the real device as clearer water drips into the lower vessel. Instructor places a “testing required” card beside it with only a simple flask icon, leaving accurate wording for post.
Audio: pouring, dripping, concise narration: “Filtration can remove some particles; safety still requires appropriate treatment and testing.” No drinking, absolute purity claim, reverse flow, magic color change, brand, or watermark.

15 seconds, 16:9, careful museum documentation workflow for a fictional ceramic fragment. Artifact lock: one rust-red curved shard with three incised parallel lines and a chipped lower corner; preserve every edge and mark.
00:00–00:05: Conservator places the shard on a neutral gray foam support using both gloved hands, then positions a scale bar and color card without covering the object. Static overhead camera.
00:05–00:10: Camera switches to a 45-degree macro slider. One raking light moves from left to right, revealing the three incised lines and surface deposits; the artifact never rotates by itself.
00:10–00:15: A turntable rotates the support exactly 90 degrees while the camera stays fixed. End with four small preview frames arranged around the artifact as a conceptual catalog layout, with all text areas blank.
Audio: quiet archive room, foam contact, camera shutter. No restoration invented on screen, no culturally specific claim without evidence, no artifact redesign, no bare-hand contact, logo, or watermark.

title_zh: Inclusive science demonstration with sign language
prompt:
18 seconds, 16:9, accessible science explainer about condensation. Presenter lock: Deaf adult educator with shoulder-length dark hair, cobalt-blue shirt, neutral backdrop; sign-language interpreter reference defines signing motion only, not identity. Keep hands fully inside frame from waist to head.
00:00–00:06: Presenter signs the opening while a chilled metal cup and room-temperature cup sit on the table. No spoken mouth movement is required. Camera remains in a stable medium shot with clear hand contrast.
00:06–00:12: Cut to close-up: droplets form on the outside of the chilled cup. Simple arrows show water vapor from surrounding air reaching the cold surface; no water passes through the cup wall.
00:12–00:18: Return to the same medium shot. Presenter signs the conclusion and points first to the air, then the outside droplets. Reserve lower third for accurate captions added in post, but generate no fake text.
Audio can contain only room tone and optional soft foley; accessibility does not depend on audio. No cropped hands, altered signs, presenter identity drift, leaking cup, auto-generated captions, logo, or watermark.

title_zh: Preventing allergen cross-contact in a small kitchen
prompt:
18 seconds, 16:9, food-service training demonstration in a fictional café kitchen. Show process discipline without making a universal safety guarantee. Worker lock: black cap, white shirt, blue apron, clean gloves. Workstation lock: red allergen board, white standard board, two knives, separate covered ingredient bins.
00:00–00:06: Worker receives an order indicated only by a purple allergy icon, washes hands, changes gloves, and clears the preparation area. Camera shows each action fully without time skips.
00:06–00:12: Worker takes the red board and its dedicated knife from a closed rack, wipes the sanitized counter, and opens only the purple-marked ingredient bin. The standard white board remains on the far shelf.
00:12–00:18: Worker prepares one simple sandwich, closes the ingredient bin, places the order in a separate tray, and verbally confirms, “Separate tools and ingredients used.” End before service to allow site-specific verification.
Audio: sink, glove, container latches, exact confirmation. No claim of zero risk, shared knife, ingredient teleportation, hidden cleaning, brand, customer data, generated policy text, or watermark.

15 seconds, 2.39:1, educational night-sky comparison using the same fictional town viewpoint, date, weather, Moon position, lens, exposure, and camera tripod. The difference is only outdoor-lighting design.
00:00–00:05: Scenario A uses unshielded cool-white fixtures that send light upward. A pale sky glow reduces the visible contrast of the Milky Way; street and building geometry stay sharp.
00:05–00:10: A physical shutter transition reveals Scenario B with warm, fully shielded fixtures directed toward paths. Ground visibility remains adequate while upward scatter is reduced and more stars become visible under the same exposure.
00:10–00:15: Split screen aligns both horizons. Simple arrows identify upward spill versus downward-directed light; leave label boxes blank for accurate typography added in post.
Audio: quiet insects, distant road, narrator: “Shielding and appropriate brightness can reduce wasted upward light.” No impossible instant galaxy, different weather, exaggerated darkness, claim that one fixture solves all pollution, brand, or watermark.

title_zh: 屋顶铜管乐队的日落现场
prompt:
15 秒，16:9，写实现场音乐纪录片，城市旧楼屋顶日落。原创四人铜管乐队：红帽小号手、蓝衬衫长号手、白裙圆号手、黑背带裤苏萨号手；人物、乐器和左右站位全程一致。
0–5 秒：摄影机从楼梯口手持走上屋顶，乐队正在演奏轻快放克乐句；近处晾衣绳掠过镜头形成自然揭示，夕阳在乐器表面产生移动反光。
5–10 秒：摄影机绕乐队外侧移动 60 度，不进入中心。红帽小号手演奏短独奏，其他三人保持节奏并看向他；呼吸、手指按键和乐器动作与音乐同步。
10–15 秒：远处另一栋楼的居民打开窗户拍手，乐队在最后一个齐奏重音同时向前踏一步，然后保持静止一秒。摄影机轻轻抬高露出城市天际线。
声音为现场铜管、脚踩拍和城市远声，无额外配乐、无对白。不要乐器变形、不要人员增减、不要嘴离开吹口时仍持续演奏、不要品牌或舞台文字。

10 秒，9:16，轻松社交舞蹈短片，午夜自助洗衣房。主角锁定：短银灰发、紫色宽松卫衣、黑色阔腿裤、白色运动鞋；背景固定三台圆窗洗衣机，无品牌无文字。
0–2 秒：音乐前奏只有洗衣机旋转声，主角靠着折叠桌用脚尖打拍，摄影机固定全身景。
2–6 秒：鼓点进入，她完成四个简单连贯动作：右肩弹动、左脚滑半步、双手在胸前交叉再打开、转身 180 度。每个动作对齐一次重拍，鞋底保持接地，不瞬移。
6–8 秒：洗衣机同时进入脱水，圆窗衣物形成背景旋转图形；摄影机只向前推进，不跟着旋转。
8–10 秒：音乐突然停，她正要做大动作却被烘干机提示音打断，停顿 0.5 秒后无奈耸肩，形成喜剧结尾。
荧光灯与紫蓝霓虹混合，手机拍摄质感但画面清晰。声音：洗衣机、放克电子节拍、提示音。无歌词、无字幕、无额外舞者、无肢体复制、无机器位置变化。

12 秒，16:9，温暖幽默的家庭音乐短片。72 岁老人，短白发、圆框眼镜、棕色针织背心、浅蓝衬衫，坐在堆满旧磁带的书房；人物脸、服装和桌面设备一致。
0–4 秒：近景，他把一盘无文字磁带放入旧录音机，按下播放键，先传出缓慢爵士鼓采样。他认真点头两次，用铅笔在纸上记节奏。
4–9 秒：节拍加重，他对着桌面小麦克风说四句简短中文节奏词：“旧钟还在走 / 茶水刚入口 / 年纪写在脸 / 节拍在心头”。口型自然，每句之间有停顿，右手只做简单打拍。
9–12 秒：孙女只以画外手伸入，悄悄把节拍速度旋钮调快；老人跟不上半拍，抬眼看向画外，随后笑着按下停止键。镜头停在两人碰拳的手上。
声音以磁带轻噪、鼓采样和真实人声为主，无自动和声。无字幕、无品牌、无夸张街头服装、无快速复杂舞蹈、非说话者不入镜。

8 秒，1:1，写实萌宠喜剧，明亮客厅。一只橘白短毛猫戴轻量蓝色软项圈，地面是一只很小的四旋翼玩具无人机，吊着一只红色条纹袜；猫花色、项圈、无人机与袜子保持一致。
0–2 秒：无人机离地 20 厘米缓慢靠近猫，袜子随气流轻摆；猫坐着，先只用眼睛跟随，再把头向右倾斜。
2–5 秒：无人机停在猫面前，猫伸出左前爪轻碰袜子一次，袜子从夹子脱落盖在猫头上；无人机因失重小幅上升后稳定，不撞到猫。
5–8 秒：猫停顿 0.6 秒，从袜子下露出一只眼睛，然后向前一步让袜子滑到脖子位置；无人机缓慢降落，画外主人忍不住轻笑。
自然窗光、真实毛发与空气动力，固定低机位。声音：旋翼轻响、布料、猫轻声呼噜、画外笑声。无动物受伤、无高速飞行、无额外爪子、无袜子颜色变化、无文字。

title_zh: 办公室盆栽的反向会议
prompt:
10 秒，16:9，干巴幽默的办公室短片。会议室里三名同事穿普通商务休闲装，桌中央是一盆茂盛绿萝；人物左右座位、服装和绿萝花盆保持一致。
0–3 秒：固定广角，三人严肃看着空白投影幕，只有空调声。左侧同事准备发言，绿萝一片叶子缓慢转向他。
3–7 秒：他说“本周的核心目标是减少无效会议。”中间同事点头，右侧同事准备记录；此时绿萝的几片叶子像听众一样依次朝发言者转动，但茎秆仍符合植物弯曲，不长出脸或手。
7–10 秒：发言结束，三人同时看向绿萝。停顿 0.8 秒后，投影仪自动熄灭，绿萝叶片转回窗户方向；三人默默起身离开，只留下植物。
冷白办公灯与窗边自然光，镜头不移动。对白普通话、语气平静，无字幕、无笑轨。不要植物说话、不要快速生长、不要人物换座、不要屏幕乱码或公司标志。

title_zh: 无缝循环：月亮装进口袋
prompt:
6 秒，9:16，无缝循环的梦幻社交视频，简洁剪纸动画。深蓝夜空与米白屋顶，一个穿红色斗篷的小旅行者站在烟囱旁，手持空的圆形布袋；角色外观和屋顶构图固定。
0–2 秒：一轮小月亮从画面上方缓慢下降，旅行者打开布袋，月亮像轻球一样落入袋中，夜空随之变暗但星星位置不变。
2–4 秒：布袋发出柔和白光并逐渐鼓起，旅行者用双手举高，风把红斗篷向左吹动。
4–6 秒：他把袋口朝上打开，月亮弹回天空，沿与开头相同的垂直路径回到初始位置；布袋恢复空瘪，天空亮度和第一帧完全一致，最后姿势回到开头。
纸张层次、有限色块、轻微投影，动作节奏像呼吸。声音：布料、柔和弹跳音、六拍音乐循环，尾音与开头衔接。无文字、无额外角色、无月亮复制、无镜头移动、无首尾亮度差。

10 seconds, 16:9, full-body performance plate on an evenly lit chroma-green cyclorama. Original adult performer wears a charcoal fitted motion costume and a long matte ivory cape with no reflective trim. Preserve face, body proportions, costume, cape length, and screen color.
00:00–00:03: Performer stands centered in neutral pose with arms slightly away from torso. Camera locked at waist height, 50mm-equivalent lens, full body and cape fully inside frame.
00:03–00:07: Performer takes two measured steps forward, turns left 90 degrees, and raises right arm. A controlled fan from frame right moves the cape left with visible inertia; feet remain grounded.
00:07–00:10: Performer returns to front, lowers arm, and holds still for one second. Cape settles naturally and never touches frame edges.
Production constraints: uniform green without gradients, tracking markers only if explicitly added later, no cast shadow beyond a soft contact shadow, no camera movement, no motion blur hiding edges, no green spill on cape, no props, text, logo, or watermark.

15 seconds, 2.39:1, untextured white-model previsualization for an original warehouse conversation scene. Set lock: six columns, loading door, staircase, two crates, overhead walkway. Characters are neutral gray mannequins A and B with clear chest letters represented only as simple colored shapes, not generated text.
00:00–00:05: Camera begins behind the left crate at shoulder height, dollies forward 2 meters as mannequin A enters through the loading door.
00:05–00:10: Camera arcs right 45 degrees around A while mannequin B descends exactly four visible stair steps and stops on the landing. Preserve screen direction and never cross the A–B axis.
00:10–00:15: Camera settles into a balanced two-shot with A frame left and B frame right; both hold neutral poses for two seconds to evaluate composition.
Use uniform diffuse lighting, no textures, no facial animation, no final-film atmosphere. Keep set dimensions, mannequin colors, path, and camera height consistent. No cinematic fog, explosions, extra props, impossible wall passage, text, logo, or watermark.

12 seconds, 1:1, neutral ecommerce geometry test. Product lock: original low-top sneaker with off-white canvas upper, dark teal heel panel, gum sole, seven eyelets per side, flat cream laces, no logo. Preserve silhouette, eyelet count, stitching, colors, and sole thickness.
The sneaker rests on a matte light-gray turntable and completes exactly one clockwise rotation over 12 seconds. Camera is fixed at midsole height with an 85mm-equivalent product lens. Lighting is a large softbox above-left plus low fill; reflections and shadows rotate only as expected from the object's changing surface orientation. Hold the first and final front-left three-quarter view for 0.5 seconds so they match.
Audio: quiet turntable motor only. No camera orbit, no foot inside, no lace movement, no material morph, no changing eyelet count, no duplicate shoe, no text, logo, or watermark.

14 seconds, 16:9, controlled stop-motion transition from the provided first frame of a rough clay block to the provided final frame of an original simplified portrait bust. Preserve table, rotating base, sculptor hands, tool set, background, and lighting from both anchors.
00:00–00:05: Hands press the clay block into a head-and-shoulder volume through visible incremental stop-motion changes. Material volume is conserved; trimmed clay accumulates in one tray.
00:05–00:10: A wooden tool defines eye sockets, nose plane, and mouth line in a believable order. The base turns no more than 45 degrees to access the side; features do not appear all at once.
00:10–00:14: Fingers smooth only the cheek and brow, then rotate the bust to the exact final-frame orientation. Hands leave frame and the final pose holds for one second.
Audio: tactile clay and tool sounds, no music. No human skin transformation, no perfect photoreal face, no extra tools, no clay appearing from nowhere, no mismatch with end-frame silhouette, text, or watermark.

title_zh: Local edit: change only the window weather
prompt:
Edit only the weather visible through the office windows, changing a clear afternoon into gentle early winter snow. Preserve every interior pixel relationship: the two employees, faces, clothing, hand actions, computer screens, desk objects, reflections, camera path, focus changes, timing, and room lighting.
Outside only: replace blue sky with pale overcast, add sparse snow moving downward-right according to the existing wind, soften distant building contrast, and allow a very thin snow layer to accumulate only on exterior horizontal ledges. Window reflections must continue to show the same interior and camera movement. Do not put snow, fog, or breath inside the climate-controlled office.
Keep the original audio exactly unchanged. No identity edits, wardrobe edits, new people, interior color grade shift, moving buildings, frozen windows, readable text change, logo, or watermark.

title_zh: One scene planned for three aspect ratios
prompt:
10 seconds, master 16:9 composition designed to crop safely to 1:1 and 9:16. Original scene: a bicycle mechanic in a cobalt apron pumps a repaired tire at the center of a compact workshop. Keep face, apron, bicycle, pump, and background tools consistent.
00:00–00:04: Medium full-body shot with subject and bicycle inside the central 40% safe zone. Mechanic connects the pump hose and presses down once; hands and valve remain visible in all crops.
00:04–00:07: Camera makes a subtle 8% push-in only. Pressure gauge sits just below center, while decorative shelves remain expendable at left and right edges.
00:07–00:10: Mechanic spins the wheel by hand, watches one full rotation, then gives a small satisfied nod. Hold a centered final frame with clean space above, never placing essential information near horizontal edges.
Audio: pump, freewheel, workshop ambience. No lateral camera move, off-center subject, tool teleportation, changing crop during generation, brand, text, or watermark.

title_zh: Three references with one role each
prompt:
Reference roles are strict and separate:
Image 1 supplies only the original dancer's identity, short curly hair, silver jumpsuit, and white boots.
Video 1 supplies only the five-beat footwork rhythm and weight shifts; do not copy its person, clothing, room, camera, or background.
Image 2 supplies only the amber theater stage, three vertical light panels, and polished black floor.
Generate a new 15-second performance. 00:00–00:05: locked medium-wide front view establishes the dancer and stage; she performs the five-beat footwork once at natural speed. 00:05–00:10: camera tracks left two meters as she repeats the rhythm with an added arm sweep, feet maintaining the same timing. 00:10–00:15: camera stops; she turns front, lands both feet, and holds the final pose while the three light panels dim from left to right.
Audio: original percussion matched to five beats, no copied music. Preserve identity, outfit, stage, floor reflections, and foot contact. No reference blending, costume from Video 1, extra dancers, body distortion, text, logo, or watermark.

title_zh: Phone UI action matched to real-world result
prompt:
12 seconds, 9:16, clean fictional smart-home interaction demo. Phone lock: black device, blank status bar, three large abstract room cards; room lock: one warm table lamp, closed blinds, ceiling light off. Do not require small readable text.
00:00–00:04: Over-shoulder close-up. Thumb taps the lamp card once; the card changes from gray to amber and the real table lamp in background turns on after a natural 0.2-second response. Show clear contact and no other UI changes.
00:04–00:08: Thumb drags the same card slider halfway; lamp brightness reduces smoothly while room exposure stays fixed so the change remains honest.
00:08–00:12: Focus shifts from phone to lamp. The hand lowers but keeps the phone in frame; lamp remains at half brightness and the other room devices remain unchanged. Finish with negative space for real interface labels in post.
Audio: two subtle interface tones and room tone. No floating holograms, unreadable fake text, duplicate phone, delayed random lights, exposure pumping, brand, or watermark.

title_zh: Seamless loop with matched first and last frame
prompt:
8 seconds, 1:1, seamless photoreal tabletop loop. A clear glass marble travels through an original small brass kinetic sculpture: left ramp, central circular track, right lever, and return channel. Lock camera, sculpture geometry, marble size, lighting, and background.
00:00–00:02: Marble begins at the exact top-left start mark and rolls down under gravity, contacting the brass ramp with realistic acceleration.
00:02–00:05: It enters the circular track, completes one full clockwise loop, and exits toward the right lever; reflections rotate across the glass without changing marble shape.
00:05–00:07: Marble depresses the lever, which tips the return channel upward. The marble rolls behind the central disk and reappears near the top-left.
00:07–00:08: Lever resets and marble settles on the exact start mark with the same reflection and zero velocity as frame one. Hold for two frames before looping.
Audio forms an eight-beat mechanical loop with brass clicks aligned to contacts. No hidden hand, perpetual acceleration, extra marble, geometry shift, camera movement, text, logo, or watermark.

title_zh: Continuity slate for wardrobe and hand props
prompt:
12 seconds, 16:9, neutral continuity-reference plate for an original café character. Identity lock: adult actor with short dark curls, mustard cardigan, white collar, black watch on left wrist. Prop lock: blue ceramic cup with chipped handle, folded newspaper, silver pen. Preserve every side and placement.
00:00–00:04: Static front medium shot. Actor stands in neutral pose, turns both empty hands toward camera, then lowers them. Even soft lighting and color chart remain at frame edge.
00:04–00:08: Cut to seated left-side profile at the café table. Actor holds the blue cup in the right hand, watch visible on left wrist, newspaper below the cup, pen parallel to table edge. Hold for two seconds.
00:08–00:12: Overhead insert records exact prop positions; actor places the cup back on its marked ring and removes both hands. End on a clean still frame suitable for comparison.
Audio: slate clap once, room tone, cup contact. No performance emotion, costume redesign, watch switching wrists, cup-chip repair, prop movement between angles, text, brand, or watermark.

title_zh: Clean background plate and controlled object removal
prompt:
Create two matched deliverables from the original locked-off 8-second street-corner shot.
Version A, clean plate: remove only the parked red bicycle and its contact shadow from the wall. Reconstruct the occluded pale brick, curb, and two paving joints using surrounding texture and perspective. Preserve pedestrians, tree movement, passing bus, reflections, camera, exposure, timing, and original audio exactly.
Version B, object-isolation check: keep the original bicycle but replace the surrounding scene with flat middle gray, preserving every bicycle edge, wheel spoke, handlebar, basket opening, and contact shadow as a separate visible element. Do not change bicycle geometry.
No new pedestrian, brick repetition artifact, flicker, moving repair patch, missing reflection, bicycle redesign, camera stabilization, color-grade change, text, logo, or watermark.

12 seconds, 16:9, restrained launch film for a fictional team analytics workspace called Northline. Do not invent performance numbers, client logos, or awards.
00:00–00:04: In a quiet operations room at dawn, a project lead opens a laptop showing an abstract, legible dashboard layout with blank chart labels. Start over the shoulder and slide slowly right; three cards reorganize into a single priority column through clear cursor actions.
00:04–00:08: Match cut from the dashboard timeline to paper task cards on a nearby glass wall. Two teammates move one card from “review” to an unlabeled completion area, then exchange a small nod. Preserve the same people, clothing, room, and blue-gray palette.
00:08–00:12: Return to a clean wide shot. The laptop, wall, and morning city sit in one visual line; a soft notification pulse appears once and the team resumes work. Finish with negative space on the left for real post-production copy.
Audio: keyboard, paper card, distant ventilation, one soft notification; minimal warm synth. No fake metrics, unreadable paragraphs, floating UI, typing without hand contact, brand imitation, watermark, or triumphant crowd.

15 seconds, 9:16, credible creator-course ad for an original ceramic artist. Identity lock: 40-year-old instructor, short wavy hair, moss-green apron, small silver hoop earrings; keep the same face, hands, apron, studio, and wheel.
00:00–00:04: Direct-to-camera medium shot. She says in natural English, “Center the clay before you shape the idea.” No subtitles. Her hands rest on a real uneven clay cylinder.
00:04–00:09: Cut to a top-down demonstration: wet hands press inward, the clay becomes centered, then rises only two centimeters. Show pressure, water, and wheel rotation honestly; do not time-lapse into a finished vase.
00:09–00:13: Side close-up of one student repeating the same motion while the instructor corrects the wrist angle with one gentle gesture.
00:13–00:15: Return to the instructor holding the intentionally imperfect first cylinder. She smiles and says, “Start here.” Leave clean lower space for an added call to action in post.
Audio: real voice, pottery wheel, wet clay, quiet studio. No invented testimonials, follower counts, instant mastery, extra fingers, perfect product jump, on-screen text, logo, or watermark.

18 seconds, 16:9, documentary podcast trailer in a small independent studio. Three hosts remain fixed: a Spanish-speaking woman in a red cardigan on frame left, an Arabic-speaking man in a gray shirt at center, and an English-speaking woman in a denim jacket on frame right. Preserve faces, microphones, seating, and eyelines.
00:00–00:05: Slow slider move across microphones as the first host says in Spanish, “Cada calle guarda una memoria.” The other hosts listen with closed mouths.
00:05–00:10: Cut on a tape-machine button press. The second host says in Arabic, “ونحن نسأل من يتذكرها.” with a calm Levantine delivery. The first and third hosts remain silent.
00:10–00:14: The third host says in English, “This week, the market after midnight.” A field-recording waveform moves only in the computer background; do not require readable UI text.
00:14–00:18: All three lean slightly toward the table as a night-market ambience fades in. Pull back to reveal acoustic panels and one warm lamp; end on their shared attentive pause.
Audio priorities: exact voices, room tone, tape click, distant market sound, no music under speech. No speaker overlap, automatic subtitles, fake sponsor logos, microphone duplication, changing seats, or mouth movement from listeners.

15 seconds, 16:9, reassuring public-service walkthrough for a fictional telehealth kiosk in a rural community center. No diagnosis, treatment claim, patient data, or real medical brand.
Identity lock: older adult with close-cropped gray hair, navy cardigan, walking cane kept on the right; staff member with teal lanyard and beige shirt. Keep identities, clothing, kiosk geometry, and room layout consistent.
00:00–00:05: Wide shot establishes a step-free entrance and uncluttered route. The older adult approaches at a comfortable pace while the staff member waits beside, not in front of, the kiosk.
00:05–00:10: Over-shoulder close-up. A large high-contrast interface presents three simple abstract buttons; the person taps the center option once, and a privacy screen slides into position. Show finger-to-screen contact and a clear response.
00:10–00:15: The staff member points to the camera indicator, then steps back to preserve privacy. The older adult adjusts the chair height and looks at the screen; finish before any consultation begins.
Audio: room ambience, soft interface confirmation, staff says, “You’re in control; I’ll be right outside.” No subtitles. No medical advice, inaccessible stairs, hidden consent, tiny text, exposed records, logo, or watermark.

15 seconds, 16:9, inclusive welcome film for a fictional evening design conference. Show accessibility as part of the real journey, not as a symbolic montage.
00:00–00:05: Exterior-to-lobby gimbal move follows two adult attendees: one uses a manual wheelchair and wears a yellow jacket; the other wears a charcoal coat and uses a white cane. They enter through the same automatic main doors as everyone else. Preserve identities, mobility aids, and travel direction.
00:05–00:10: Cut to a stable lobby wide shot showing a low check-in counter, tactile floor route, quiet-room symbol represented by a simple icon, and an interpreter desk. A staff member gestures toward two equally direct routes without touching either attendee.
00:10–00:15: Inside the hall, camera settles at seated eye level. Open wheelchair spaces are integrated among seats, caption screens show abstract line blocks rather than fake words, and a sign-language interpreter prepares at stage side. End before the talk starts.
Audio: doors, lobby ambience, short spoken welcome, clear but quiet room tone. No inspirational slow motion, segregated entrance, blocked route, magical disappearance of mobility aids, illegible claims, brand, or watermark.

12 seconds, 1:1, clean material explainer for a fictional reusable shipping box. Product lock: matte blue-gray rectangular case, two green corner latches, fold-flat inner divider, blank tracking patch; preserve dimensions, latch count, divider, and color.
00:00–00:04: Top-down shot. Two hands open both latches in sequence, lift the lid, and remove a returned ceramic cup. The cup and packaging remain undamaged; no hidden extra compartments.
00:04–00:08: The hands wipe the divider once, fold it along visible creases, then place a different authorized sample object inside. Camera rotates only 20 degrees while the product stays centered.
00:08–00:12: The lid closes, both latches click, and the blank tracking patch emits one subtle scan glow. Match cut to three identical cases stacked securely, showing the repeat-use idea without a numerical environmental claim.
Audio: latch clicks, cardboard-fabric fold, scan tone. Neutral daylight and honest texture. No greenwashing statistics, disposable box transformation, changing latch count, floating components, logo, text, or watermark.

15 seconds, 2.39:1, atmospheric teaser for an original community sound archive. The exhibition contains donated cassette players, headphones, photographs with no readable personal data, and a circular listening table.
00:00–00:05: In a dark gallery before opening, macro camera travels past cassette buttons, worn handwritten label textures with text kept out of focus, and headphone cushions. A red record light turns on once.
00:05–00:10: Match the spinning cassette reel to the circular listening table. An archivist wearing cotton gloves places one cassette into a clear case; visitors' silhouettes enter slowly in the far background.
00:10–00:15: A teenager and an older visitor sit across from each other, each listening to one side of the same recorded street sound. Their expressions shift from concentration to recognition; camera rises to reveal a wall made of abstract sound-wave light.
Audio transitions from tape hiss to a distant tram bell, market voices, and rain under an awning; no identifiable copyrighted music. No false historical claims, readable private names, nostalgia cliché montage, duplicate artifacts, brand, or watermark.

15 seconds, 16:9, clear visual explainer of a fictional neighborhood solar-and-storage system. Use a realistic block with six homes, one community center, rooftop panels, a battery room, and an existing utility connection; preserve building count and cable routes.
00:00–00:05: Morning aerial at modest height, not a satellite view. Sunlight reaches rooftops from frame right; thin amber flow lines move from panels toward the community battery. Camera descends toward street level.
00:05–00:10: Cutaway view of the secured battery room shows three fixed cabinets. During a passing cloud, rooftop generation lines dim and blue stored-energy lines travel back toward homes. Use arrows as simple motion graphics without numeric claims.
00:10–00:15: Evening street view. Essential lights remain on while residents use normal amounts of energy; the utility connection is still visible, emphasizing a hybrid system rather than total independence. End on the community center exterior.
Audio: light neighborhood ambience and subtle electrical hum. No “free energy” claim, impossible perpetual power, exposed high-voltage equipment, changing house count, company logo, text, or watermark.

14 seconds, 16:9, operational walkthrough for a fictional temperature-sensitive food parcel. Package lock: white insulated tote, blue zipper, one blank e-ink status tile, two sealed meal trays; preserve product count, seal state, and tote geometry.
00:00–00:04: At a packing bench, a worker scans the blank tile and closes the blue zipper fully. A simple green ring confirms handoff; no customer name or address is visible.
00:04–00:08: Match cut to the tote secured upright in a delivery van. Camera stays fixed as the van moves; the tote does not slide, and a small indicator changes from transit blue to arrival amber without numbers.
00:08–00:11: Courier carries the same tote level to a shaded pickup locker, opens one compartment, and places it inside. Hands maintain contact and the zipper remains sealed.
00:11–00:14: Recipient opens the locker, checks the green status ring, then unzips the tote at a kitchen counter; both trays are intact. Finish before food is served.
Audio: scanner, zipper, vehicle ambience, locker click. No invented compliance certification, exposed address, broken seal, package teleportation, changing indicator location, brand, or watermark.

15 seconds, 16:9, calm consumer-safety walkthrough for a fictional bank app, focused on recognizing and reporting a suspicious card alert without showing real financial data or promising reimbursement.
00:00–00:05: An older adult in a rust cardigan receives one clear phone notification represented by a shield icon and a blank transaction card. Camera stays over the shoulder; the person does not tap a link inside a message.
00:05–00:10: They close the notification, open the bank app from the known home-screen icon, and use a large “review” control represented by an abstract eye symbol. The app displays two large choices; the person selects the warning-colored option once.
00:10–00:15: A confirmation screen offers a verified support-call button and temporary card lock. The person locks the card, then places the phone down and writes the official number from the physical card on paper, with digits kept out of focus.
Audio: one notification, two confirmation tones, narrator: “Open the trusted app directly; never share a code with an unexpected caller.” No account balance, personal name, guaranteed outcome, panic montage, tiny text, real bank logo, or watermark.

18 seconds, 16:9, practical field-service training film. A technician in safety glasses and navy coveralls repairs a fictional compact packaging machine while a remote specialist appears on a rugged tablet. Machine lock: red isolation handle, transparent guard, two rollers, one sensor bracket; preserve all parts and safety state.
00:00–00:06: Technician stops the machine, turns the red isolation handle to locked position, and verifies zero movement before opening the transparent guard. The tablet specialist watches silently.
00:06–00:12: Technician points the tablet camera at the loose sensor bracket. The remote specialist draws one simple circle overlay around the bracket and says, “Check the upper fastener first.” No floating 3D parts or invented measurement.
00:12–00:18: Technician tightens the existing fastener with one tool, closes the guard, removes the personal lock, then runs a slow test. Both rollers move evenly and the specialist gives one thumbs-up.
Audio: real voice, tool contact, guard latch, low test motor. No bypassed lockout, hands near moving rollers, automatic self-repair, changing machine geometry, customer data, brand, or watermark.

10 秒，9:16，第一视角手机探店，冬日清晨的街边豆浆摊。摄影者的双手偶尔进入画面，穿深棕针织袖口；摊主是戴白色棉帽、穿藏蓝围裙的中年女性，身份与服装保持一致。
0–3 秒：手机从蒸汽后方靠近摊位，自动曝光因白色蒸汽短暂变暗后恢复；摊主掀开锅盖，蒸汽向上散开，镜头轻微后退躲避。
3–7 秒：她用长柄勺将热豆浆倒进素白陶碗，液面上升真实，摄影者把一小碟酥脆油条推到旁边。手持微动自然，不进行电影式环绕。
7–10 秒：摄影者双手捧起陶碗，镜头随之略微上升；背景自行车从左向右经过，摊主笑着说“慢点，烫。”
对白普通话、亲切自然，无字幕。声音：锅盖、液体、街道自行车铃、远处早市交谈。冷晨光与摊位暖灯混合；不要品牌招牌、不要额外手指、不要夸张蒸汽遮满全程、不要让陶碗变成纸杯。

title_zh: 海边民宿的 15 秒入住日记
prompt:
15 秒，9:16，自然手机旅行 Vlog，剪辑轻快但不炫技。主角锁定：短发女性旅行者，白色亚麻衬衫、卡其短裤、帆布托特包；只在镜面中短暂出现脸部。
0–4 秒：第一视角推开浅蓝木门进入海边民宿，门轴轻响，室内从背光逐渐自动曝光；一只橘猫从右侧慢慢经过，不看镜头。
4–8 秒：动作匹配切到托特包放在藤椅上，摄影者拉开白色窗帘，海面和小渔船出现；窗帘被海风吹向镜头形成遮挡。
8–12 秒：遮挡后切到阳台桌面，手放下一杯冰柠檬水，杯壁凝露明显；镜头轻微俯拍记录明信片、钥匙和贝壳。
12–15 秒：镜头转向栏杆外落日，橘猫跳上空椅但不打翻物品，尾巴掠过镜头结束。
自然海风、木门、冰块和海鸟声，只有很轻的原声吉他。无对白、无字幕、无酒店品牌。保持房间方位、托特包和猫的花色一致；不要无人机镜头、不要过度稳定、不要快速 360 度旋转。

12 秒，16:9，近距离美食纪录片，热闹夜市但主体清晰。一位戴黑色头巾、灰色围裙的摊主在圆形炭炉上烤三根玉米，工具和玉米数量保持一致。
0–4 秒：50mm 中近景，摊主用金属夹逐根翻面，炭火因油滴短暂冒出小火苗，火焰不超过玉米高度；摄影机轻微手持前移。
4–8 秒：超近景刷上红褐色酱汁，刷毛弯曲、酱汁沿玉米纹理流动，炭灰与热浪造成真实空气扰动。背景灯笼只形成柔和散景，不出现可读文字。
8–12 秒：摊主撒上芝麻和香草，把其中一根放入牛皮纸托递向镜头；焦点从玉米转到他满足的眼神，顾客的手从下方接住。
声音：炭火噼啪、刷酱、金属夹、模糊人群，摊主只说“这一根刚好。”自然普通话，无字幕。不要火灾、不要食物无限增殖、不要手穿过玉米、不要品牌标识。

title_zh: 旧城电车窗边的雨天旅行
prompt:
10 秒，4:3，怀旧旅行日记，坐在旧城有轨电车窗边。前景固定一只手握着浅绿色纸质车票，手腕戴棕色皮表；窗框、木椅和车票全程不变。
摄影机始终坐姿高度朝窗外，轻微随车体摇晃。雨滴在玻璃上向后斜流，街景以合理视差经过：近处骑楼柱快速移动，中景行人撑伞缓慢移动，远处钟楼几乎不动。第 4 秒电车转弯，暖黄色车内倒影短暂覆盖窗外；第 7 秒对向电车经过形成自然遮挡，遮挡后手把车票轻轻翻到背面但不需要可读文字。最后停站，雨滴运动减缓。
声音：轨道摩擦、雨、车厢木结构轻响、一次到站铃。无配乐、无对白。不要现代 LED 屏、不要乱码标牌、不要让手和车票漂移、不要把窗外变成高速公路。

title_zh: 周末陶艺课的失败与修复
prompt:
12 秒，9:16，真实社交短视频，明亮陶艺工作室。主角是一名穿米色围裙的初学者，双手沾灰白陶泥；老师只出现穿深绿袖口的双手。陶轮、泥团与围裙全程一致。
0–4 秒：手机固定在桌边略微俯拍。陶轮转动，主角试图拉高杯壁，杯口因压力不均向右塌下；她停顿一秒，发出无奈的轻笑，而不是夸张表情。
4–8 秒：老师的双手从左侧进入，示范降低手掌、用拇指稳定中心；主角跟随动作，塌下部分被缓慢压回矮碗形，陶泥守恒、不凭空增加。
8–12 秒：主角松开手，歪但完整的小碗继续旋转，她用沾泥的手背擦额头，留下一小道泥痕；镜头自动对焦短暂落在泥痕后回到作品。
声音：陶轮电机、湿泥摩擦、两人轻笑，老师说“慢一点，先找中心。”无字幕、无音乐。不要额外手指、不要陶器突然完美、不要快速时间流逝、不要品牌。

title_zh: 山村早餐的无旁白 ASMR
prompt:
15 秒，16:9，安静自然的山村早餐纪录片，无旁白。一名穿深蓝棉麻上衣、头发低低束起的女性在木窗旁准备一碗菌菇面；人物脸、服装与厨房陈设保持一致。
0–5 秒：晨光穿过木窗，微距拍摄菜刀把两朵香菇切成薄片，刀每次完整接触木板，动作熟练但不加速；背景水壶开始冒出细蒸汽。
5–10 秒：中近景，她把面条放入陶锅，用竹筷轻轻分开，汤面产生真实旋涡；摄影机沿灶台缓慢横移，焦点依次经过火苗、锅沿和她专注的侧脸。
10–15 秒：碗放到窗边木桌，加入香菇和一小把葱。她坐下，先吹散蒸汽再尝一口，窗外远山被薄雾覆盖。镜头停住两秒让蒸汽自然上升。
声音前景为刀与木板、汤水、筷子和轻呼吸；远景为鸡鸣和山风；无音乐、无对白。食材数量连续，蒸汽不遮脸，火焰受控；无古装表演感、无字幕、无商标。
